title: A Busy Tuesday
setting: A bright living room and a park.

characters.name: Leo
characters.look: a tall boy with short brown hair

characters.name: Mia
characters.look: a small girl with a red hat

sentences.en: It is a sunny Tuesday morning.
sentences.zh: 这是一个阳光明媚的星期二早晨。
sentences.scene_prompt: A tall boy with short brown hair looks out a window at the sun.

sentences.en: Leo is a really tall boy.
sentences.zh: 里奥是一个非常高的男孩。
sentences.scene_prompt: A tall boy with short brown hair stands next to a small door.

sentences.en: Mia also wears a red hat.
sentences.zh: 米娅也戴着一顶红色的帽子。
sentences.scene_prompt: A small girl with a red hat stands next to the tall boy.

sentences.en: They walk quickly from the house.
sentences.zh: 他们从房子里迅速走出来。
sentences.scene_prompt: A tall boy and a small girl walk quickly away from a small house.

sentences.en: The park activity is really fun.
sentences.zh: 公园里的活动非常有趣。
sentences.scene_prompt: A tall boy and a small girl watch children playing in a green park.

sentences.en: They eat lunch without any food.
sentences.zh: 他们吃午餐，但是没有任何食物。
sentences.scene_prompt: A tall boy and a small girl sit on a bench with empty plates.

sentences.en: Mia starts to cry with nothing.
sentences.zh: 米娅因为什么都没有而开始哭泣。
sentences.scene_prompt: A small girl with a red hat cries while sitting on a park bench.
